response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS examination_count FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), totals AS (SELECT SUM(examination_count) AS total_examinations, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM counts) SELECT c.ID, c.examination_count, 1.0 * c.examination_count / t.total_examinations AS fraction, 1.0 * c.examination_count / t.total_examinations - 1.0 / t.group_count AS excess FROM counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE 1.0 * c.examination_count / t.total_examinations > 1.0 / t.group_count ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10;
